speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The glass was once yesterday, Mistress. The wardens have had their say, and I kept to it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Once is a Christian length, Master Thwaite.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: A cloud of witnesses, to be followed. Not sued to. I will not say it again this morning. There is no feast in the book today.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No, sir. The almanac is blank of it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Then we will not write it in. Morning prayer is prayer. What a house does after is the house's.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I said at supper what I had to say. Six years, and the ink boiled of a Monday. I am not making a second sermon of it in the porch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You said it. I had nothing to put after it then, and I have nothing now.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The horn is the old horn, sir. She boils the new tomorrow, as she said she would. Monday.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Monday. Not because a leaf is blank. Because the receipt is Monday.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Master Verbeke went out by the north door yesterday. He said Ghent kept both ways in one street, and it went ill. I did not take it up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. He may keep his street. I am not asking him for mine.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. The house has had one supper of it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Sir John sat his pew and looked at his book. No sword-bearer. There has been none since Wednesday, and the oriel stays dark.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have not been to the gate. I did not look for a word from him.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Nor should you. He is a parishioner. He is not the Mayor. God give you the day.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you, sir.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will eat. It is short of the notch, and it is a penny, and I am not opening a baker on a Sunday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny, and short. I will not argue it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is on the Holinshed. I will not lift him. It is Master Field's, and the cat does not read.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The cat may keep it till dinner. You may keep the afternoon. There is no play, and you are not starting the vault to fill a Sunday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no play today. I am not going up the lane.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then let it wait. Dinner is threepence, if you sit to it. Master Verbeke keeps his room.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Three trenchers. I will not set a fourth for a feast the book does not have.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I have said more than a porch requires. One glass yesterday. None today. I commend you to your dinner.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And you to yours, sir.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am coming in.
